= Egress clause fixtures

Copied verbatim from `metadatastician/standards`: `valid/` and `invalid/` from
`1-formats/deed/tools/fixtures/egress/` (ADR-009), and `rsr-template-repo_chora.deed`
from `fixtures/valid/` there, last re-copied at standards `830b0d3`
(2026-11-16). `test/deed_test.exs`
asserts that `Hypatia.Deed` accepts and rejects exactly what the standards
checker `deed_lint.js --egress` does. Re-copy them when that directory changes;
do not edit them here.

`template-main/rsr-template-repo_chora.deed` is the estate template's live deed,
copied from `hyperpolymath/rsr-template-repo` main at `202085a` (2026-11-14), with its
`(egress …)` clause for three jobs. It is the worked model every repo deed is
written from, so the reader must keep accepting it.
